change: Apache Maven — Resolve a dependency range regardless of repository order
deployment: Both complete pinned maven-artifact modules. No production runtime dependency.
assumptions: Start a fresh JVM with unpopulated range caches. Use actual VersionRange, DefaultArtifactVersion and ComparableVersion for all six candidate orders.

questions.observer: Record construction or its exception, selected member of the range and independent highest-version fold in all six orders.
questions.basis: The historical three-way cycle has three possible winners. On the fix construction succeeds and x wins every order.

questions.observer: Construct a range from 1-alpha through 1-beta and select from all six positions with repeated beta.
questions.basis: The usual alpha-before-beta order and range selection agree.
